correctness.rationale: For irrational α=φ^−1, distinct ordinal permutations occupy the n arcs cut by −jα mod 1 and their probabilities are precisely arc lengths. Consecutive Fibonacci convergents form a unimodular basis; the coefficient sign/index argument gives exact predecessor distances α^(m−1),α^m when F_m≤n<F_(m+1). The one split changes entropy by Cα^(m−2), and exact Binet summation yields H_n=(m−2)lnφ+C(1−(−α²)^(m−2))/5+(n−F_m)Cα^(m−2). Binet limits n/F_m→t∈[1,φ] yield scaled-gain [L,φL] and entropy-defect range from strictly convex G(t). Checked direct sorted irrational-rotation gaps and Shannon H_n for n≤250; max finite discrepancy 3.41e−13, not a substitute for the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Possible older equivalent Sturmian entropy formulas affect originality rather than proof correctness; ordinal time-shift conditional entropy is not claimed.

value.rationale: The exact entropy-increment staircase and full log-periodic defect profile quantify finite-resolution information of an otherwise zero-entropy uniquely ergodic dynamical system. These precise finite-block probabilities and worst-phase oscillations are natural invariants useful as benchmarks for Sturmian sources and ordinal-statistics calculations; no new three-gap theorem is asserted.
